name: Get contacts in a list
description: Get contacts in a list. Retrieve all contacts belonging to a specific list, identified by its list ID. Results are paginated with a default of 50 contacts per page (maximum 500) and sorted in descending order of creation. You can optionally filter contacts by their modification date using the modifiedSince parameter.
